items.quote: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt
items.claim: The text (verse 4:20) says Moses put his wife and sons on a donkey and went back to the land of Egypt.
items.action: returned with his wife and sons
items.object: his wife and his sons, set upon an ass

items.quote: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.
items.claim: The text says Moses carried the 'rod of God' in his hand when he went back to Egypt.
